description: Create the local wallet that pays for secrets beyond the free tier (0.005 USDC each on Base), if none exists, and get a funding link for its owner. Funding needs only the address; send the user `fundUrl` and ask them to send a little USDC on Base (1 USDC = 200 secrets). The private key stays in a local file and is never shown to you. Set backup_to_owner only if the user wants a copy of the key: it's placed in a one-time link for them.

backup_to_owner.description: Also create a one-time link containing the private key for the owner. Default false.

name: ncrypted_wallet_setup
title: Set up a payer wallet
